sections.name: Section A - Knowledge Check
sections.instructions: Multiple-choice, auto-scored. Complete in one sitting (~25 minutes). No external resources.

sections.name: Section B - Technical Deep-Dive
sections.instructions: Written responses reviewed by the allocated assessor against a quality rubric. 60 minutes.

sections.name: Section C - Case Study
sections.instructions: Two customer scenarios. Assessor scores each against five-point criteria rubrics; evidence notes are mandatory. 90 minutes.
